# agentic-playbooks

> A local runner for agentic playbooks: YAML playbook definitions, a svelte-flow web visualizer, semver versioning, and an MCP server so coding agents can drive playbooks. Rust workspace, edition 2024. The binary is called `apb`.

The MCP server (started with `apb mcp`) identifies itself as `agentic-playbooks` to MCP clients. The binary name and all CLI commands use `apb`.

## Install

Prebuilt binaries: macOS (Apple silicon, Intel) and Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+ or a static musl build). No Windows or Linux ARM binaries. apb drives coding agent CLIs you install separately (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, Grok, Hermes, Qoder, Antigravity, Pi, ZCode).

The one-liner installer works everywhere a prebuilt binary exists:

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/releases/latest/download/apb-installer.sh | sh
```

This installs the `apb` binary to `CARGO_HOME` (`~/.cargo/bin` by default), no
build tools required. Update with `apb self-update`.

Homebrew (macOS, Linux x86_64) is equivalent; update with `brew upgrade apb`:

```sh
brew install itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/apb
```

The `apb` crate on crates.io is an unrelated project: `cargo install apb` does not install this tool.

Fall back to a source build only if the installer is not usable in your
environment (for example, no network access to GitHub Releases). This
requires Rust (stable) and Bun; the web frontend must be built before the Rust
binary because it is embedded at compile time via rust-embed.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks && cd agentic-playbooks
(cd web && bun install && bun run build)
cargo install --path crates/apb-cli
```

`cargo install --git` is not supported: git mode builds in a private cargo cache where `web/dist` cannot be placed. Install from a local clone (`--path`).

Verify the installation:

```sh
apb --version
apb doctor
```

## Connect to a coding agent (MCP)

`apb mcp` starts a stdio MCP server on the current project's `.apb/` directory. Use the name `agentic-playbooks` when registering it.

Claude Code (project scope):

```sh
claude mcp add agentic-playbooks -- apb mcp
```

Claude Code (global scope):

```sh
claude mcp add --scope user agentic-playbooks -- apb mcp
```

Project `.mcp.json` (shareable, commit to repo):

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "agentic-playbooks": { "command": "apb", "args": ["mcp"] } } }
```

Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`):

```toml
[mcp_servers.agentic-playbooks]
command = "apb"
args = ["mcp"]
```

OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`, mcp section):

```json
"agentic-playbooks": {
  "type": "local",
  "command": ["apb", "mcp"],
  "enabled": true
}
```

Run `apb init` in each project where you want to use playbooks. The MCP server discovers `.apb/` relative to the current working directory.

## CLI commands

```text
apb init            create the .apb structure
apb list            playbooks and versions
apb validate        validate playbooks, the profiles and scripts they reference, profile models, requires and connectors
apb run <id>        run a playbook (--confirm-irreversible: consent without a terminal)
apb runs            list runs (apb runs <id> [--json]: one run with its execution mode)
apb wait <run>      block until a run finishes, needs input or stops
apb resume <run>    resume a paused or interrupted run
apb stop <run>      stop a run
apb review          decide a pending human_review node
apb answer          answer an interactive node's pending question
apb tasks           list or submit host tasks (host execution mode)
apb note            post a supervisor note to a run
apb export          export a playbook (with layout) to a bundle file
apb import          import a playbook bundle into this project
apb trash           list deleted playbooks, restore one with its versions
apb trust           list approvals (trust.json), revoke by digest or id
apb profile         manage agent profiles
apb connector       list or manage connectors
apb detect          detect installed coding agents
apb adopt           adoption readiness report for a playbook
apb subscriptions   view or declare agent subscriptions
apb suggestions     inspect and undo recorded suggestion decisions
apb migrate         migrate schema 1 playbooks to schema 2
apb doctor          diagnose environment, or one run with --run
apb cache           inspect and manage the node result cache
apb decide          ask the configured decision providers a bounded question (host tasks, scripts)
apb decisions       decision-model report, stored thresholds, replay
apb stats           cross-run metrics per playbook version and node (read-only)
apb eval <id>       run a playbook's eval cases in scratch repositories, store and compare pass counts
apb projects        list or manage the workspace registry
apb dashboard       web UI on port 7321
apb ingest          only the inbound webhook listener (headless)
apb server          manage server-mode API keys
apb dev             dev mode: Vite HMR frontend + API server (source tree)
apb mcp             stdio MCP server for coding agents
apb self-update     update apb to the latest release
```

## Architecture

Six crates under `crates/` with dependency direction core <- engine <- mcp, cli and server on top, and `apb-decide` (no workspace dependency) <- engine, mcp:

- `apb-core`: domain layer (no async). Playbook schema, validator, profiles, registry, versioning, trust store, atomic state IO.
- `apb-decide`: blocking, provider-agnostic decision-model client (typed questions, provider chain, cache).
- `apb-engine`: execution. Drive loop, node execution, immutable run manifest, agent adapters, append-only event log, background supervisor.
- `apb-mcp`: rmcp stdio MCP server, policy gate, profile and supervisor tools.
- `apb-cli`: package name `apb` (bin `apb`); thin dispatch.
- `apb-server`: axum web API with the svelte frontend embedded via rust-embed.

## Docs

- [Install guide](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): detailed installation methods and environment checks
- [MCP tools reference](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): full tool surface, annotations, safety model
- [Run stats](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/STATS.md): `apb stats`, cross-run metrics from the run journals
- [Eval suites](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/EVALS.md): `apb eval`, cases next to a playbook's versions, repeated runs in scratch repositories, results per configuration
- [Host integration](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/HOST-INTEGRATION.md): tier-0 instructions delivery, client compatibility
- [Profile authoring](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/PROFILES.md): how profiles bind agent + model + fallbacks + skills
- [Playbook authoring guide](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/HOWTO-authoring.md): node types, edges, conditions, params, templating
- [Guardrails](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/GUARDRAILS.md): which controls advise and which enforce, by layer; project hooks under the minimal environment
- [Running apb in CI](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/CI.md): `apb run --detach` plus `apb wait` exit codes, config and secrets, trust in CI
- [Connectors](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/CONNECTORS.md): calling external services (HTTP, mail, chat) from playbooks, accounts, secrets, trust
- [Deployment](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): running the dashboard on a server behind a TLS proxy with API keys
- [Decision models](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): optional small models for completion checks, judge nodes, retry advice and catalog ranking
- [Interactive agents](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/INTERACTIVE-AGENTS.md): `interactive: true` nodes that ask the user a question mid-run
- [Playbook interview](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/HOWTO-interview.md): how an agent interviews a user to capture a process as a playbook
- [Feedback loop](https://github.com/itechmeat/agentic-playbooks/blob/main/docs/FEEDBACK-LOOP.md): how agents report apb defects found during supervised runs
